name: Differentiable Inverse Graphics Framework
aliases: Differentiable Inverse Rendering for Joint Reconstruction
definition: A fully differentiable pipeline that infers latent 3D scene parameters (geometry, materials, lighting) from images by optimizing them via gradient backpropagation from rendering losses.
summary: The Differentiable Inverse Graphics Framework infers 3D scene parameters from images by optimizing them via gradient backpropagation through a differentiable rendering pipeline, distinguishing itself through its foundational reliance on the analysis-by-synthesis loop.
